title: Why does mapping everything into MP4 fail?
fullTitle: FFmpeg -map 0 Into MP4: 4 of 10 Stream Types Fail, 6 Copy

scenes.narration: You copy a file into m p four with dash map zero, and f f m peg says: could not find tag for codec. Which stream is the problem? We copy ten stream types, one at a time, and read the stream list before and after.
captions: -map 0 into mp4: which streams make it fail?
Ten stream types, read before and after.

scenes.narration: Each source is a video plus one extra stream: five audio codecs, cover art, three subtitle formats, a font attachment. The control copies video, five audio and cover art together: seven streams in, seven out. Readers: f f probe, and the m p four boxes.
captions: Readers: ffprobe, and the mp4 boxes in Node.

scenes.narration: Six of ten pass: a a c, opus, flac, P C M, vorbis and cover art. The cover art becomes a second video track. The stream list after matches the list before, and the video frames are the same fifty hashes as the source.
captions: 6 of 10 pass: aac, opus, flac, pcm, vorbis, cover art.
Stream list after equals before. Same 50 video hashes.

scenes.narration: Four of ten fail: subrip, a s s, web v t t and the font attachment. The message names the codec. The output is a zero byte file with no moov box, and f f probe cannot open it. The video was never the problem.
captions: 4 of 10 fail: subrip, ass, webvtt, ttf attachment.
Zero byte output. No moov box.

scenes.narration: Put them in one file, and half fixes fail one by one. Convert the subtitle to mov text: the font attachment fails next. Dash s n removes subtitles: the attachment stays. Drop the attachment: subrip is still there.
captions: -c:s mov_text alone: the attachment fails next.

scenes.narration: Both together work: drop the attachment with minus map zero colon t, and convert the subtitle to mov text. Seven streams out: video, five audio, mov text. The cue text is in the bytes. Or map video and audio only: six streams.
captions: Cue text found in the bytes and in a decode.

scenes.narration: Dash map zero is fine for video, audio and cover art. Subtitles need mov text, and attachments must go. Count streams before and after. Not tested: other containers, data streams, bitmap subtitles, real files, other builds.
captions: Count the streams before and after.
Not tested: other containers, data, bitmap subs, real files.
